description: The donut chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2, categorizing its contents into six distinct components. The largest segment, represented by a light green color, corresponds to "Pending Translations" and accounts for 43,000 entries. The second largest segment, in yellow, represents "Translated Sentences" with a count of 45,387. The third largest, a blue-gray section, is labeled "Extra + Augmented Data" and contains 30,000 entries. A brownish-orange segment, labeled "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)," makes up 23,108 entries. The smallest two segments are "Moroccan Names" (orange) and "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)" (purple), which are visually very small and are not labeled with specific numerical values in the chart. The chart includes a legend on the right side that matches the colors to their respective categories.
